nodes.label: T4 scope sentence (s95 draft)
nodes.rationale: One paragraph at the head of the Formal Derivation Statement declaring the derivation conditional on H3-H5, naming V5 as an estimate not a bound, and stating the above-112 regime by attribution rather than as derived — rewritten if M builds libshoot_dirac.

nodes.label: H4 as the condition under which a partially filled subshell exists
nodes.rationale: Not a convenience: unrestricted Hartree-Fock leaves no degenerate level partially filled (Bach-Lieb-Loss-Solovej 1994), so the Challenge's own vocabulary is a restricted-field vocabulary and H3/H4 are asymptotically warranted as to total energies while bounding no differential margin.

nodes.label: Law B and the Z <= 112 domain
nodes.rationale: Delta_SO(entrant) < m(Z) holds on 94/94 scored rows with a maximum 0.854 at Z=105 and fails first at Z=113; its first-order form reproduces the Dirac-Fock (n,l,j) sequence 24/24 for 109-120, and above 112 the ordering object becomes the relativistic shell under the Dirac-Coulomb-Breit field.
